Retrieved via Exa 19 July 2026. Al Jazeera (AP/Reuters), BBC, Anadolu.

EIGHTH NIGHT (overnight Sat 18 -> Sun 19):
- CENTCOM: US forces began new airstrikes "Today at 6 p.m. ET" (Saturday, ~23:00 BST) on Commander-in-Chief's direction. CENTCOM statement at 03:30 GMT Sunday (04:30 BST) confirmed completion of the EIGHTH consecutive night.
- CENTCOM: strikes "designed to further degrade Iran's ability to threaten commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and swiftly punish Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces who launched attacks against American service members in Jordan last night." Targeted "Iranian military coastal surveillance and air defence facilities, maritime capabilities, and missile and drone storage sites."
- Locations hit (Iranian media / Mehr / Tasnim): area near Sirik (Hormozgan), Qeshm Island (at least six missiles on its outskirts), jet sounds over Kish Island, Bandar Abbas, near Shadegan in Khuzestan. BBC: Iranian media said an under-construction nuclear power plant at Darkhoveyn (Khuzestan) was struck, plus a desalination plant on Qeshm.
- IRNA: Bonji desalination plant destroyed, cutting water to ~10,000 people.
- CENTCOM said more than 50,000 US troops remain deployed across the Middle East, "highly vigilant, focused, lethal, and ready."

IRAN RETALIATION (Sunday):
- Iran's army said Sunday it launched a large-scale drone attack on two US military facilities in Kuwait: an ammunition depot at Camp al-Adiri and air-defence radars at Ali Al Salem airbase. Kuwaiti military said its air defences were "confronting hostile missile and drone attacks" after "sinful Iranian aggression."
- Kuwait said the same power and water distillation plant was hit for the SECOND time in two days, starting a fire.
- Bahrain sounded air-raid sirens Sunday (Manama); interior ministry urged residents to shelter. Middle East Eye: sirens for sixth time in several hours; IRGC said it destroyed a US MQ-9 drone over Ahvaz.
- IRGC (Sunday, BBC): two vessels ignored Iranian warnings not to transit the Strait of Hormuz and were involved in "an accident"; warned all vessels using "unsafe routes" will "certainly face accidents."
- US embassy in Amman said Jordanian authorities evacuated Aqaba airport and seaport due to a "specific and credible threat"; a Jordanian government spokesperson promptly DENIED this.

CASUALTIES: BBC - US death toll now 16 after a US Navy pilot missing earlier this month was declared dead. Iran health ministry: at least 50 killed, 500+ wounded in US strikes over past three weeks. Iranian attack on Jordan killed two US service members, one missing; four medically evacuated then discharged.

QUOTES:
- Trump (Sunday): the deaths were "a very sad thing"; "We're never allowing Iran to have a nuclear weapon." (Declared the June agreement "over" on 8 July.)
- Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth: "Godspeed, heroes. Their sacrifice only stiffens our resolve."
- Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei (written statement, Sat late): America's "repeated breaches" of the agreement "laid bare a fundamental truth: the signature of the US president is utterly worthless and devoid of credibility"; warned of "unforgettable lessons."
- Major-General Ali Abdullahi, commander of Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Central HQ (state media, Sunday): "any aggression or barbarism will be met with a decisive and devastating response"; called US "the Great Satan."
